text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One key area is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of written words. NLP is also used for translation, so people can communicate across different languages more easily. Another important use is sentiment analysis, where computers identify whether a text is positive, negative, or neutral, which is helpful for companies checking customer opinions. Finally, chatbots use NLP to answer questions and talk with users in a natural way. Thanks to NLP, our daily interactions with technology are becoming simpler and more useful.
